column3: verify_unlisted early-return flips to `-ne 0`, so the SURFACE UNLISTED sweep is skipped whenever scan dirs exist (pristine.sh:241). Only `undeclared-file` plants an undeclared child in a declared scan dir and asserts exit 1 + token SURFACE UNLISTED; the clean tree has no unlisted child, so no other case's pass condition depends on the sweep.

rows_min `-ge`->`-gt` (pristine.sh:435) breaks the equality boundary got==floor. The intact-db cases pin that boundary (part rows 1 vs floor 1): `clean` (exit 0 + SURFACE OK) and `runtime-absent` (exit 0). `row-floor` exercises 0<1, which fails under both operators, so it cannot witness this change.

crosscheck `!=`->`==` (pristine.sh:229) flags agreement instead of disagreement. `crosscheck-disagree` builds baseline 644 vs census 600 and asserts exit 1 + SURFACE CROSSCHECK (mutant passes silently); `clean` carries baseline 600 == census 600 and asserts exit 0 (mutant flags it). Both cases drive the mutated branch.

the symlink guard is deleted (pristine.sh:200-204), so the declared-exec symlink falls through to the live-kind check and prints SURFACE DIVERGED (live symlink) instead of SURFACE LINK. `symlink-swap` asserts exit 1 + token SURFACE LINK. No other case creates a symlink.

the exec-bit arm is deleted (pristine.sh:214-217). NONE: no selftest case creates a declared-exec path that is a regular file without the execute bit — the only exec path (.local/bin/the-janitor) is created 755, and `symlink-swap` is intercepted by the earlier symlink guard. Fixture-absent arm: no assertion can witness this mutation.

magic compare `head -c ${#value}+1` -> `${#value}` (pristine.sh:371) makes the 15-byte read no longer match the 16-byte expected file, so the positive magic path fails on the real sqlite header (`SQLite format 3\0`): `clean` and `runtime-absent` assert exit 0 there. Note `sqlite-magic-prefix-only` (the case built for the NUL contract) still passes under the mutant — a 15-byte read still differs from the 16-byte expected — so it cannot witness this change.

N_UNVERIFIED += 2 (pristine.sh:405-406) changes only the summary count; the three sqlite-dependent shape rows print unverified=6 instead of 3. `sqlite-unavailable` is the only case asserting the DRIFT line token `unverified=3`.
die() exits 1 instead of 2 (pristine.sh:85). The two refusal cases that assert exit 2 go red: `malformed-row` (bad kind) and `fused-shape-row` (too many fields). Both route through die().

the missing-path class test flips `runtime`->`asset` (pristine.sh:191), swapping GONE (failure) and ABSENT (not a failure) for missing paths. `asset-gone` asserts exit 1 + SURFACE GONE for the missing asset (mutant prints ABSENT, exit 0); `runtime-absent` asserts exit 0 for the missing runtime file (mutant prints GONE, exit 1).

the CLEAN summary's ok= argument becomes $N_ABSENT (pristine.sh:862). NONE: no selftest case asserts the CLEAN summary line's ok= field; the `clean` case's token SURFACE OK is matched by per-path SURFACE OK lines, which the mutation does not touch.
